9,Story,[US-01] Register a hardware asset,"*As a* IT Administrator, *I want to* register a device with its serial number, warranty and purchase details, *so that* every asset the organisation owns is tracked from the day it arrives.
h3. Backlog details
h3. Acceptance criteria
* A valid request returns 201 with status {{AVAILABLE}}
* A unique tag {{HW-YYYY-NNNNNN}} is generated when none is supplied
* A duplicate tag, serial number or MAC address returns 409
* Invalid data returns 400 and a non-admin role returns 403
h3. Definition of Done
* Work done on a feature branch, never committed straight to main
* Pull request raised by the assignee and reviewed by a repo owner
* All five CI/CD stages green on the PR
* Automated test TC-HAM-01 passing
* Traceability still correct in the SRS and Test Plan
* Issue moved to Done on the board",High,5,ITIM Sprint 1,Gaurav Girish,,Hardware Asset Management,epic-hardware,SP-5,sprint-1

h3. Backlog details

* Cost 1200, salvage 200, life 5y, age 2y gives 200/year and book value 800 (SL)
* WDV at 25% gives 675 for the same asset
* Book value never falls below salvage
* A date before purchase, or invalid parameters, returns 400
